featured_reviews.name: Avinash Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had at this pet store, and honestly I’m still upset thinking about it. From the moment I walked in, the place felt poorly maintained and depressing. The floors were dirty, there was a strong smell in the air, and the overall environment looked like it hadn’t been properly cleaned or cared for in a long time.

What really broke my heart, though, was seeing the kittens. There were about 15 kittens that looked barely two months old crammed into a single tiny cage. The cage was far too small for that many animals. They were all climbing over each other, scratching at the bars, and trying desperately to get out. Several of them looked extremely stressed and scared. Instead of playful, curious kittens like you’d expect, they just looked sad and uncomfortable. Watching them push against the cage door and meow was honestly heartbreaking.

It didn’t seem like they had enough space, stimulation, or proper care. The bedding looked dirty, and the whole setup felt more like storage than a place for living animals. Seeing such young kittens packed together like that made the entire experience feel really upsetting.

To make matters worse, everything in the store was wildly overpriced. Basic supplies that you can find elsewhere for reasonable prices were marked up way beyond what they should cost. When a store is already poorly maintained and clearly not prioritizing animal welfare, charging inflated prices just makes the whole thing feel even more frustrating.

The staff also didn’t seem particularly attentive or concerned about the animals. When I asked a question about the kittens, the response felt dismissive and rushed, as if my concerns weren’t important.

Between the overcrowded cages, the sad-looking kittens, the poor maintenance, and the ridiculous prices, this place left a really bad impression. A pet store should be a place where animals are treated with care and respect, not crammed into tiny cages and left in uncomfortable conditions.

I genuinely hope the store improves how it cares for its animals, because what I saw was really disappointing and upsetting. Until then, I would strongly recommend people look elsewhere for their pets and supplies.
Animals are living organisms with emotions not objects that you can treat however you want.I request you all to have a look and raise this issue,as a cat lover,this genuinely broke my heart.

Also I've been to the store many times and you never asked me my name so you can't say that when you reply.this is not a fake review.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Rasika Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
My overall experience at PoshPets was satisfactory, with a few points worth highlighting for pet parents.

The store itself is well stocked — they offer a wide variety of pet foods, numerous treat options, and essentials such as pet wipes. Their toy selection is moderate but adequate. I was also informed that they provide several clinical services, including X-ray, 2D Echo, ultrasound, dental care, and have a veterinarian available on call. I did not use these services, but it is reassuring to know they are offered.

My visit this time was primarily for grooming my two Golden Retrievers. The grooming results were decent, and the overall job was acceptable. However, I did feel disappointed with the way the drying process was handled. They became anxious with the sound of the dryer, and I sensed the staff were a little rough or rushed, which made the dogs increasingly uncomfortable.

At one point, when I was trying to comfort them, a staff member asked me to wait outside — something I strongly disagreed with. As their pet parent, leaving them alone with strangers while they were visibly anxious was simply not an option for me. One of the dogs, who rarely barks, was barking continuously, which further indicated discomfort. Whether it was the air pressure of the blower or just the handling, they were not as calm as they usually are with me or at the other salon we frequent.

For comparison, I regularly visit another salon, which is smaller but far more gentle and consistent in their handling. I have never been asked to leave the room there, and my dogs have always been comfortable throughout the process.

Overall, PoshPets is a great place for pet supplies, and I would definitely return for shopping. However, for grooming, I would prefer to go elsewhere unless absolutely necessary, as I am particular about how my pets are handled — even the slightest roughness is not acceptable to me.

The kittens began exhibiting serious symptoms, including foaming at the mouth and extreme drowsiness, which prompted an emergency visit to the veterinarian. It was a distressing experience for us and the couple who supported the rescue.

Thankfully, the kittens received prompt veterinary care and are now in recovery. We are closely monitoring their condition and remain hopeful that they will make a full recovery without long-term neurological effects.

This incident has been a difficult and eye-opening experience, emphasizing the importance of using only vet-prescribed products, especially with young or vulnerable animals. We sincerely hope no other rescued or domestic animals face a similar situation due to misinformation or inappropriate product recommendations
